findings.issue: H5493 is qal sequential imperfect 3ms (intransitive: turn aside/depart). הָעָרֹב is the subject that departs. Spanish keeps Jehová as agent and makes the swarm the object (“apartó el enjambre”), changing stem force and participants.

notes: The rest matches the tokens: hizo Jehová conforme a la palabra de Moisés; de Faraón, de sus siervos y de su pueblo; no quedó uno.
